title: Nepal floods: Chinese national rescued alive from hydropower tunnel on Day 10

title: 3-year-old Iowa girl reads 1,000 books in 8 months before starting kindergarten
content: a 3-year-old girl in Iowa signed up for a local library challenge with a simple goal: read as many books as possible before starting kindergarten . by early September, just eight months later, she had reached a milestone that many adults would find daunting: 1,000 books . the challenge is part of a nationwide effort known as 1,000 Books Before Kindergarten .
